overview:
Democratic Rep. John Mannion seeks another term in a central New York district that leans Democratic by about four points. He enters the general election with a large financial advantage, having raised roughly $3.1 million and holding $1.4 million on hand, while Republican Kailee Buller has raised about $429,000. No outside groups have spent against Mannion, and no public polls or expert ratings cover the race.

Prediction markets on Kalshi and Polymarket both price Mannion's chances in the mid-90s. The fundamentals point to a double-digit Democratic margin, helped by a national environment favoring the party in a midterm year. With no polling to check those fundamentals, uncertainty stays wide, but the weight of the evidence places this seat firmly in the likely Democratic column rather than in pure toss-up territory.
